parsed_payload.reasoning: Let the leg be AD and let O be the incenter. Since O is the center of an incircle, it lies on the angle bisectors of ∠A and ∠D. Because the trapezoid has parallel bases, the consecutive interior angles ∠A and ∠D along leg AD are supplementary: ∠A + ∠D = 180°. Thus half of ∠A plus half of ∠D equals 90°, so in triangle AOD, ∠OAD + ∠ODA = 90°. Therefore ∠AOD = 90°. Given OA = 5 and OD = 12, triangle AOD is a right triangle with legs 5 and 12. Hence AD = √(5² + 12²) = √169 = 13. The length of the side is \boxed{13}.
